lead.headline: Blast and fire at MRPL refinery near Jokatte: one dead, nine hurt
lead.deck: A high-pressure cold separator ruptured in the Coker Hydrotreater Unit around noon on Wednesday, MRPL said.
body: A blast followed by a fire hit the Coker Hydrotreater Unit of Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL) near Jokatte at about 12.15 pm on Wednesday, 30 September, while testing was under way, according to news reports. MRPL said a high-pressure cold separator had ruptured, causing the fire.

Reports say one person died and nine were injured. The person who died was a 30-year-old contract worker from Mulki who was first reported missing; his body was found later. Rajesh Baptist, from Surathkal, suffered burns over about 35 per cent of his body and is in the intensive care unit at Srinivas Hospital, where doctors say he is out of danger. The other injured were given outpatient treatment and medical checks.

Early reports quoted the Police Commissioner as saying eight people were hurt and the fire was under control; later reports raised the count to nine injured and one death. Nearby areas felt the impact of the explosion. This paper will follow official statements as they come.

stories.title: Heavy rain forecast for the coast
stories.text: The Meteorological Department has forecast heavy rain in the coastal districts of Udupi and Dakshina Kannada. The five-day forecast on this page gives a rain chance of at least 67 per cent every day, rising to 100 per cent on Saturday and Sunday.

stories.title: Mangalore University drops 16 postgraduate programmes
stories.text: Mangalore University has temporarily discontinued 16 postgraduate programmes for the 2026-27 academic year after they failed to attract the minimum number of students needed to run the courses.

stories.title: Credit society opens Bajpe branch on 2 October
stories.text: The Bantwal Catholic Credit Co-operative Society's Bajpe branch is scheduled to open on 2 October.

stories.title: Student dies in balcony collapse
stories.text: A 16-year-old student died after a balcony collapse. Two people have been booked in connection with the incident.

stories.title: Gang members arrested in burglary case
stories.text: Two members of a gang from Uttar Pradesh were arrested in a house burglary case in Udupi.

stories.title: Sax replica reported stolen from park
stories.text: A replica of Kadri Gopalanath's saxophone has reportedly been stolen from Mallikatta Park.

stories.title: Youth drug awareness campaign
stories.text: Srinivas University and IPSLM ran a 'Nasha Mukta Yuva' campaign for youth drug awareness.

stories.title: Four cars damaged at Katapady
stories.text: Four cars were damaged in a serial accident at Katapady.

sports.headline: West Indies pile up 405 in Guwahati; India strike four golds at the Asian Games

items.title: 2nd ODI: West Indies make 405 for 7
items.text: West Indies scored 405 for 7 in the second one-day international against India at Guwahati on 30 September, with centuries from Jangoo (114), Hope (104) and Campbell (101). Reports call it West Indies' first total of 400 in ODI cricket. India began their chase afterwards; the result was not in when this page was prepared.

items.title: India's best day yet: four golds
items.text: On Day 12 in Aichi-Nagoya, India won gold in the women's team, mixed team and men's team compound archery events, and in the mixed trap team shooting event. India also took four bronze medals in boxing and wrestling, including the first wrestling medal of the Games.

items.title: Women's hockey team into the final
items.text: India's women's hockey team beat South Korea 2-0 to reach the Asian Games final, where they will face China for gold.

items.title: Both kabaddi teams won gold
items.text: India's men's and women's kabaddi teams both won gold at the Asian Games; the kabaddi tournament ended on 26 September.
items.source: Wikipedia, Kabaddi at the 2026 Asian Games
